speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your current symptoms: has the flank pain persisted since your recent sinusitis treatment, and do you notice any changes in your urine, such as color or frequency? Additionally, have you experienced any nausea or chills alongside the fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any blood in your urine, and did you develop these symptoms shortly after stopping your antibiotics for the sinus infection? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Blood Culture.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis shows Leukocyturia (Present), Bacterial Culture (Negative), and Cytospin Stained With Hansel's Solution revealing 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm; Blood Culture results are not included in the provided data.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.
